method.label: Track angles two steps at a time

annotationRationale: Rotation and reflection determine the angle update. A two-step recurrence separates the even and odd positions, and coterminal angles characterize a return to the starting point.
sourceMethod: Follows the official MAA angle recurrence and its even- and odd-index formulas. It makes the full-turn condition explicit and compares the first positive return in each parity.

review.mathCheck: The angle update is \(\theta_{k+1}=180-\theta_k-(k+1)\), hence \(\theta_{k+2}=\theta_k-1\). Therefore \(\theta_{2m}=-m\) and \(\theta_{2m+1}=179-m\). Positive even indices first return at 720; odd indices first return at 359. The minimum is 359, choice A.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of official AMC 10A Problem 18, page 13. It retains the angle recurrence and parity split while explicitly explaining coterminal angles and checking both competing first-return indices.
review.annotationCheck: The source mapping, transformation order and key A agree. Negative angles and multiples of 360 are handled correctly, including exclusion of the initial even index zero. The explanation is complete for AMC 12.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact links fit rotation properties, simple recursion and coterminal angles. cnm_136 is used for the angular effect of reflection across the y-axis; this does not separately demonstrate its coordinate sign rules or drawing criteria.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: cnm_245 demonstrates distance preservation and rotation effects within its rigid-motion links, without congruence decisions or experimental verification of general line/angle/parallel properties. cnm_136's angular reflection rule does not demonstrate the coordinate/sign demands of 8.G.A.3 or 6.NS.C.6b. cnm_h200 directly supports contextual recursion under F-BF.A.1a and arithmetic subsequences under F-BF.A.2; geometric sequences and explicit recognition of sequences as functions under F-IF.A.3 are not demonstrated. cnm_h056 has no supplied US link.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: The assessed rotation, coordinate-axis reflection and recurrence nodes match the named steps. cnm_136 is exercised through its angular reflection aspect, without claiming full coordinate-rule mastery. cnm_h056 correctly supplies background knowledge for recognizing returns modulo 360.
